summary.text: On Otaria, armies converge on the city of Sanctum, where Akroma and Phage meet in mortal combat until Kamahl hurls the Soul Reaper and kills both along with Zagorka.
Their simultaneous deaths fuse them into Karona, who declares herself a goddess of magic and builds an army, leaving Otaria's armies to worship her.
Kamahl resolves that Otaria needs no goddess and fights her with the numena, and Karona is finally killed with the Mirari sword.
